This indicates a failure related to missing critical system library files in the container filesystem during layer export, likely caused by either a broken or incomplete Ubuntu 22.04 base image or issues with containerd volume/mount handling on the host. Verify the base image integrity and consider explicitly installing libc6 or related essential system libraries. Also, ensure that the Docker daemon and container runtime environment are stable and updated, as this could be an infrastructure/container runtime issue unrelated to the Dockerfile content itself.
